label: Enable calendar access
help: Allow explicit availability requests. Preparing a Run never contacts Google.

label: Allow approved bookings
help: An exact approval on decision is still required. Invites are sent only after a successful recheck.

label: Booking calendar ID
help: Explicit Google Calendar ID, such as owner@example.com; primary and calendar URLs are refused.

label: OAuth wallet reference
help: secret://workspace/google_calendar — the secret contains OAuth JSON, never paste tokens here.

label: Working time zone
help: IANA zone, for example Europe/Paris. Slots include UTC times and explicit local offsets.

label: Allowed participants (JSON)
help: Array of {"id":"alice","email":"alice@example.com","calendar_id":"alice@example.com"}. Requests select these IDs; [] allows meetings without guests.

label: Working hours (JSON)
help: Map mon–sun to intervals, e.g. {"mon":[["09:00","12:00"],["13:00","17:00"]]}. Missing days are closed. Split overnight periods.

label: Search horizon (days)
help: Furthest allowed search end from now; maximum 90 days.

label: Slot interval (minutes)
help: Start-time grid in the working time zone; meeting duration comes from the request.

label: Buffer around busy periods (minutes)
help: Keep this margin before and after each busy period across the selected calendars.

label: Minimum advance notice (minutes)
help: Rechecked at approval, immediately before the booking attempt.

label: Maximum guests per request
help: Only configured participant IDs are accepted; their free/busy calendars must be readable.

label: Maximum proposed slots
help: Return the first matching slots in chronological order.

label: Maximum meeting duration (minutes)
help: Elapsed duration, including on daylight-saving transition days.

label: Proposal validity (seconds)
help: Approval cannot extend an expired proposal. Start a new request to search again.

label: Network deadline (seconds)
help: Total deadline per operation. A lost booking response is uncertain, never retried automatically.

label: Maximum retained requests
help: Durable duplicate protection per node. No automatic deletion; refuse new requests at this limit.

label: Database limit (bytes)
help: Bound the private SQLite database; default 32 MiB. Credentials are never stored here.
